frozen_from.note: v7 supersedes v6 because #4899 changed two defaults the v6 rungs exercise, without freezing a new reference (the gate failed on main from 2026-11-22). (1) ad0e60cdba: with collection_window unset, the walked m = 3 pair-table collection scans a ceil(|F|/3) window; k0n31 leaves it unset, so its collection counters moved. (2) 45e447d9ba: the m = 3 descent walk scans a cyclic window read from collection_window; k0n41-subgroup-wide sets 207 and descends with m = 3, so its descent trials moved 346 -> 2908. Same-binary control: KIC_DESCENT_WINDOW=0 (full scan) gives v6's k0n41 counters exactly. Measured on this host (research/ic_descent_window_20261124/): the windowed descent is 2.70x faster than v6's full scan (paired per round 2.17-3.38, 5 rounds, isolated, 32/32 verified, same logarithms); 207-828 is a flat optimum. k0n53-subgroup-wide (descent_summands 2) is unchanged. Engineering (AGENTS.md section 3); no rung file changed.
